lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Hey- hey! It's us! It's us!
lines.direction: shouting after someone running away in the dark, trying to stop her bolting; two full, loud shouts of "Hey" first, one after the other, both clearly voiced, then "It's us" twice

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: [a sob as she stumbles]

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: Don't shoot! Don't shoot!
lines.direction: screamed in terror while sprinting past armed men in the dark, breathless, voice cracking; two quick shouts, both clearly voiced

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: Tomas? ...Tomas.
lines.direction: a sharp frightened gasp first, then recognition and relief breaking through; the second "Tomas" is almost a sob

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: It's me.
lines.direction: raised to carry through thick glass; steady, practised calm with tension underneath

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: I'm sorry- I saw the guns, I thought you were-
lines.direction: breathless and apologetic, words tumbling out, cutting herself off

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: I know.
lines.direction: gentle but firm, raised to carry through glass

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: It locked. When I shut it, it just- locked.
lines.direction: disbelief rising into panic, pushing at a door that will not move

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Hang on. ...Admin's sealed the medical deck. Remotely. I can't touch it from here.
lines.direction: first two words busy at a keyboard, then reading a screen and the realisation landing; quiet anger, no humour at all

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: I can give you the intercom.
lines.direction: offering the only thing he has, apologetic, subdued

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: ...Tomas? Can you hear me?
lines.direction: small and shaky, close to a microphone

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: We hear you.
lines.direction: steady and reassuring, tension under it

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Show me your hands. ...Turn around.
lines.direction: a doctor triaging: calm clinical orders, a short beat between the two

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Anything scratch you? Bite you?
lines.direction: clinical and careful, dread just under the calm

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: No. I hid. I just hid.
lines.direction: shaky and tearful, trying to be brave for him

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Good. You're fine. ...You're fine.
lines.direction: the first said to her, reassuring; the second quieter, said to himself

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: It's in the surgery. It's been in there since the lights went.
lines.direction: a frightened whisper, as if something in the next room could hear

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: It's been... moving things.
lines.direction: barely audible, terrified

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: [fast, panicked breathing, a whimper]

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Look at me. Not the door. Me.
lines.direction: low and tense, holding himself together, firm and slow

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Sit down by the beds. Breathe with me. In... and out.
lines.direction: low and slow, a doctor pacing a panicking patient through the glass; he breathes the 'In... and out.' with her, a slow audible breath in and out between the words

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: [a shaky breath] ...Okay. Okay.
lines.direction: trembling, close to tears, trying to steady herself with his breathing; a shaky breath out first, then two quiet words

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Armory's on its own circuit. That one I can open.
lines.direction: flat and focused, no humour

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Jay. Take it.
lines.direction: quiet and grim

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: I made you a coffee. Before. It's still on the counter.
lines.direction: small and wistful, holding herself together

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: I'll drink it.
lines.direction: soft and steady

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: It'll be cold.
lines.direction: almost a laugh, tearful

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: I'll drink it cold.
lines.direction: soft, warm and firm, a promise

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: [a long, tired exhale, a sniffle]

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Gotta keep moving.
lines.direction: flat and hollow, worn out, pulling himself together; quiet, not for anyone

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: I told her she was fine.
lines.direction: flat, quiet and hollow

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Med lab's through there.
lines.direction: quiet, after a long silence; purely functional

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: The door. Jay, the door!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: I can't- Tomas, I can't override it!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Christ. Oh, Christ.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Hey! HEY! Get off her!

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: Open it, open it, please-

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: [full scream]

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: [cut-off cry]

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: [a wet, rattling breath]

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Legs! Take its legs!

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: [choking]

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: Tomas, please- please-

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Big one. Shotgun, Jay. Now.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Easy. Stay tight—I don't know this section.
lines.direction: hushed, tense whisper in a dark unfamiliar industrial room; weapon up, watching the shadows

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Yeah. Eyes open—I can't see the far wall.
lines.direction: low, guarded whisper answering Okafor; scanning the dark bay

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Relax, you two. It's just the lower power bay. I've been down here a hundred times.
lines.direction: casual, unbothered, walking right past their tense whispering; warm dry amusement

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Let's see why the transit rail's dead... breakers are fine, bus pressure's holding...
lines.direction: muttering to himself while tapping the console, focused engineer diagnosing a fault

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Ha—there it is! Quarantine dumped the phase relays. Lazy lockout. Watch this.
lines.direction: sudden bright a-ha realization, pleased with himself, reaching for the switches

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Phase one... turbines waking up.
lines.direction: steady, satisfied callout over the first low generator rumble starting up

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Phase two. Rail bus taking load.
lines.direction: brisk, confident over the deepening generator hum

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: And phase three—there's our lights.
lines.direction: warm satisfaction as the final overhead banks stabilize

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: North bulkhead just cycled. That lead to the train?
lines.direction: normal speaking volume, clear steady relieved voice, not whispering, glancing toward the open north doorway

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Straight through the maintenance hall. Departure bay's on the other side—let's move.
lines.direction: brisk, ready to go, gesturing north toward the maintenance corridor

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Line One runs straight to the Arrival Terminal, yes? What's our play once we get off?
lines.direction: measured, walking briskly through an industrial corridor; steady clinical focus

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Deep-lift and the evac shuttles both stage out of R-Sixteen. If Heins or anyone from topside got a boat prepped, that's where they'll be.
lines.direction: practical, conversational while walking ahead; gravelly warmth hiding nerves

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Assuming the tunnel's clear. Think anything got down into the transit wing?
lines.direction: steady, watchful while walking down the maintenance corridor; guarded

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Blast gates stayed sealed when the grid dumped. Plus it's half a click of solid steel bore under the trench—even those things aren't swimming through that.
lines.direction: wry dry reassurance, blue-collar confidence about his station's engineering

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Good. Check your rounds before we board, Jay. I don't want any surprises when the doors open on the other end.
lines.direction: calm, firm, practical warning as they enter the departure bay

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: There she is—Line One, still on the rails and lit up. Come on, let's get aboard before something changes its mind.
lines.direction: warm relief and dry humour seeing the powered transit train waiting on the track

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Jay, inside. Once that bulkhead drops we're not coming back up this way.
lines.direction: firm, grounded, calling Jay aboard from inside the train doorway

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Door's sealed. Hold onto something—she pulls hard off the dock.
lines.direction: brisk, steady callout as the train doors slide shut and the blast gate lifts

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Whoa—rear console's lighting up. That's a live carrier.
lines.direction: surprised, alert, noticing the incoming radio hail on the rear bulkhead terminal

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: Transit Car One—Jay, is that you? I saw the lower rail bus spike back online.
lines.direction: crisp, urgent security chief over radio; relieved to catch a live signal

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Chief! Yeah, it's me—I've got Giles and Okafor. We're heading down to the Arrival Terminal.
lines.direction: genuine relief hearing Heins alive, speaking clearly toward the rear comms console

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: Thank God. Listen to me—security's pinned on the upper deck, and we lost the whole south wing twenty minutes ago.
lines.direction: fast, tense, strained command voice under pressure over radio

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Katie, what about the evacuation teams? Did anyone make it to the Arrival Terminal?
lines.direction: steady, urgent question leaning toward the comms terminal, bracing for bad news

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: Two squads took the first shuttle down. They radioed in from the concourse, then—nothing. Every camera on R-Sixteen went black.
lines.direction: grim, shaken, trying to hold professional composure over radio

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Black? You mean power's out down there too?
lines.direction: uneasy, low realization as the train starts slowing down

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: I don't know—something hit them before they could seal the dock. Jay, do NOT walk into that concourse blind—keep your weapons up and—
lines.direction: urgent, emphatic warning over radio, voice cutting off abruptly on the last word

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Lost her. Too much rock between us and the upper hull.
lines.direction: quiet, sober, no humour left, looking at the dead comms console

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: We're coming into the dock. Stay ready.
lines.direction: low, quiet, tense warning as the train glides into the arrival dock

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Attention. Primary rail traction power has been lost. Engaging reserve battery drive. Proceeding to nearest station for mandatory safety shutdown.
lines.direction: calm, smooth, overly polite automated transit PA announcement over emergency power loss; completely detached

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Arrival Terminal reached. Safety shutdown complete. Engaging auxiliary exterior lighting.
lines.direction: calm, detached automated transit PA announcement in a dark silent terminal

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Wait... is that blood?!
lines.direction: quiet shocked disbelief turning sharp as he spots dark blood pools on the floor outside the window

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Jesus Christ... that's the whole evac detail.
lines.direction: horrified, stunned quiet whisper staring out at the massacre in the concourse

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Jay, stay in the car and watch the door. August and I will clear the platform.
lines.direction: tense, firm command trying to stay steady while raising his pistol

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Flashlights on. Check your corners.
lines.direction: crisp, low tactical command stepping out into pitch darkness

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Easy, easy... up the stairs. Something's breathing in here.
lines.direction: tense hushed warning creeping forward with flashlight up, genuinely scared

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Right side! Behind the pillar—OPEN FIRE!
lines.direction: sharp panicked shout spotting a huge creature in the dark, immediately opening fire

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Light it up! Fall back, fall back!
lines.direction: panicked yelling over rapid gunfire, backing away in terror

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: What the fuck is that?!
lines.direction: YELLING at the top of his lungs, full chest voice, loud and raw over his own gunfire as a five-metre creature rears up in front of him; never quiet, never whispered

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: What the fuck IS that?!
lines.direction: the calm surgeon finally breaking, SHOUTING at full volume in disbelief over gunfire as the creature roars at him; loud, raw, never quiet or whispered
